soc4_browsing.rule: Exclude whole-word senior, chief, head/head of, manager, director, supervisor, superintendent, proprietor and team leader titles; management field terms remain.

notes.axes: Exposure and substitution are separate (r=0.26) and are never blended into one displayed number. Both are percentiles over the 816 O*NET 30.0 occupations with complete risk inputs after the senior-title filter; risk is their geometric mean. Substitution uses O*NET 30.0 Work Context plus equal-weighted Relational Work Activities, with Job Zone removed.
notes.market_jobs: A job is a SOC2020 unit group. Its axes are the unweighted mean of the scored O*NET occupations mapped to it (listed as aka); its market figures are its own. Degrees and apprenticeships inherit from the SOC4 jobs they lead to, never from O*NET directly.
notes.market_units: Degrees and apprenticeships take pay, the axes and openings from the same broad map of where their people end up. They carry NO competition figure: entrants can only be counted per occupation, so summing them over a qualification's occupations counts other subjects' graduates as if they were its own. Competition stays on the job, where numerator and denominator describe one occupation.
notes.apprenticeship_risk_proxies: Named risk-only O*NET proxies fill an axis gap only when the exact ST-to-SOC4 route has no scored child. The exact SOC4 identity and market links remain primary.
